title: Quick Pork Carnitas Tacos
subtitle: Crispy edges, fast tortilla night
description: The kind of spread that ends the "what's for dinner?" argument fast. Mexican pork crew dinner for 8 — about 45 min. Works great when you've got one person on the stove and another on sides.

ingredients.name: pork butt
ingredients.notes: 4 lbs pork butt 2 pounds Pork butt trimmed, and cut in 2" cubes; hall portion

ingredients.name: sea salt and ground pepper
ingredients.notes: 8 sea salt and ground pepper sea salt and ground pepper to taste

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.notes: 1 tsp olive oil 1 teaspoon olive oil

ingredients.name: orange juice
ingredients.notes: 0.5 cups orange juice 1/2 cup orange juice

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: In a large Dutch oven add the pork, garlic, salt and pepper, and water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover and simmer over medium low for 45 minutes to one hour.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Drain well. Watch color and texture — if it smells sharp or looks pale, give it another minute before moving on.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: When cool enough to handle, shred the meat by hand or with the tines of a fork.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Remove and discard any remaining fat. Watch color and texture — if it smells sharp or looks pale, give it another minute before moving on.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Transfer back to Dutch oven and heat the olive oil. Watch color and texture — if it smells sharp or looks pale, give it another minute before moving on.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Add the orange juice and milk and cook until liquid has evaporated and pork has browned; stirring occasionally. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: Chop onions and cilantro, and slice avocado and limes. Watch color and texture — if it smells sharp or looks pale, give it another minute before moving on.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: Place each in small individual bowls for serving. Watch color and texture — if it smells sharp or looks pale, give it another minute before moving on.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.instruction: Heat tortillas in a dry frying pan and keep warm. Watch color and texture — if it smells sharp or looks pale, give it another minute before moving on.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.instruction: For each taco, stack 2 tortillas and layer with warm carnitas, chopped cilantro, onion and avocado slices and give it a good squeeze of lemon juice.

proTips: Prep all mise en place before the bell — this meal wins on organization, not speed hacks.
Keep a backup tray warm in the oven for late calls — nothing worse than cold protein after a run.
Taste for salt at the end — hall palates run salty after long shifts.
tonightSpread: Warm tortillas in a dry skillet stack — wrap in foil so the line stays soft.
Set proteins, salsa, and toppings in separate bowls for build-your-own station flow.
Line up Quick Pork Carnitas Tacos on the main counter with serving spoons — firefighters grab fast between calls.
Keep a backup tray warm in the oven at 200°F for late arrivals after a run.
leftovers: Cool leftovers in shallow containers within two hours — deep pots stay hot too long.
Label trays with date and reheat to 165°F minimum before second shift.
